The Neo Queen fight of the Babel boss lair (scene $F6) is won: the crystal gate of the Babel upper floors (scene $E3) opens.

  - extracted/pyramid/mummy_queen_lair/pyDD_mummy_queen.asm:109 {763546}
  - extracted/babel_tower/babel_upper_floors/btE3_crystal_gate.asm:19 {624633}
  - plans/extracted-audit/mesen2-results/FR30_20261105.md:68 (FL11-13)

Notes: Setter: the neo queen watcher (code_0BA65F, spawned by btF6_neo_queen, scene $F6): after enemiesRemaining = 0 and the teleport byte $01 clear it runs Transform_ShadowToWill, SetFlagWord #$0179 and queues scene $E3 at (01F8,03A0). Agrees with the FL11 proposal. The name has the crystal gate letter e like gates a-d ($0175-$0178). Decision: the FL29 meaning (Neo Queen watcher, scene $F6) stands; the earlier proposal 'Mummy Queen rematch' is contradicted. The only setter (pyDD_mummy_queen.asm:109 {763546}) lies in code_0BA65F, spawned by btF6_neo_queen (pyDD_mummy_queen.asm:52 {763426}), which tables/scene_actors.asm:4695 places in the Babel boss lair; the Mummy Queen actor of the same file (placed at tables/scene_actors.asm:4450) does not reach it. The file sits in the pyramid folder only because of its position in the bank, which is why the inventory counts a second group for this flag.
